cases.title: Built for teams managing content at scale

features.title: Every step, visible and reversible

items.title: Research, grounded in real data

items.title: SEO and GEO quality gates
items.description: Every draft is checked against classic SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (visibility in AI answer engines like ChatGPT and AI Overviews) before it can publish. Content that fails twice never goes live.

items.title: A kill switch that actually works
items.description: Pause a site, pause your whole org, or hit the emergency stop — checked twice in every run, so nothing publishes after you've said stop.

stats.title: Guardrails, not just automation
stats.description: Every run is logged, every publish is gated, and every failure has a defined, visible outcome — so trusting an AI to publish under your brand doesn't mean flying blind.

testimonials.title: What early teams are asking us

items.title: "Will it actually stop when I tell it to?"
items.description: Yes — the kill switch is checked twice in every run, at dispatch and again right before publish, so a run already in flight still halts.

items.title: "What happens if the AI writes something bad?"
items.description: It never goes live. Content that fails the SEO/GEO quality gate twice ends the run — there's no degraded-but-published fallback.

items.title: "Do I have to review every post?"
items.description: Only if you want to. Turn on require-approval-before-publish in Settings and every run pauses for your Approve/Reject before it goes out.

items.title: "What if I don't use WordPress?"
items.description: Quillrun publishes to WordPress, Webflow, and Shopify today, or a hosted blog we provide if you don't have a CMS yet.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.description: What Quillrun does, how the quality gates work, and what stays in your control.

items.question: What is Quillrun?
items.answer: An autonomous SEO/GEO content agent: it researches a topic, drafts a post, checks it against search and AI-answer-engine quality gates, and publishes it to your own site — WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, or a hosted blog we provide.

items.question: What's GEO?
items.answer: Generative Engine Optimization — writing content that gets cited and surfaced by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews), alongside traditional SEO for classic search rankings.

items.question: Can I review posts before they publish?
items.answer: Yes. Turn on require-approval-before-publish per organization and every run pauses at an approval gate — nothing publishes without your Approve.

items.question: What stops it from publishing something bad?
items.answer: A quality gate that checks every draft against SEO and GEO criteria, with up to two corrective redrafts. If it still fails, the run ends without publishing — never a degraded post going live.

items.question: How do I stop everything immediately?
items.answer: Pause an individual site, pause your whole organization, or use the platform-wide emergency stop. All three are checked again right before publish, not just at the start of a run.
